receipts.detail: both hints builders carry the boot incarnation and the persisted value is readable pre-hydration on restart
mintBootIncarnation returns previous+1 once per boot while the 1s persistence cadence rewrites the same value
the publication owner stamps the boot incarnation onto every node state update message via ControlPlaneField.BOOT_INCARNATION
the incarnation flows through the durable nodes row (boot_incarnation column) and the heartbeat publication path
